title: Peo ya Kgotlhang
intro: Pele ga lefatshe le itse kgotlhang e e anameng, go ne ga nna le teko e e tseneletseng ya tumelo le kutlo. Kanelo e e sekaseka ditlhopho tse di dirilweng ke motho ka bongwe, yo ditiro tsa gagwe di tlhomang sekao mo dikokomaneng tse di tlang. Ipaakanyetse go phutholola kgang ya moya o o lwantshanang le lefufa le legolo le ditlamorago tsa lone tse di botlhoko.
clues: Ke ne ke le mongwe wa bana ba ntlha go tsamaya mo lefatsheng, ke le ngwana wa banyalani ba ntlha fela.
Nna le morwarre re ne ra laelwa go ntshetsa Allah setlhabelo, e leng teko ya boammaaruri jwa rona.
Tshupelo ya me e ne ya se ka ya amogelwa, fa ya ga morwarre yone e ne e amogelwa, mme seno se ne sa tlatsa pelo ya me ka maikutlo a a boitshegang.
Ke ne ka bua mafoko a go tshosetsa morwarre, ke kgweediwa ke botlhoko jwa go ganwa.
Morwarre o ne a araba ka botlhale le poifomodimo, a nkgopotsa tshiamiso ya ga Allah le go mmoifa.
Le fa morwarre a ne a bua mafoko a a bonolo le go iketleeletsa go itshwarela, ke ne ka tsaya botshelo, ka nna mongwe wa ba ba neng ba latlhegelwa.

outcome.label: Botso
options: E nnile sekao sa go ikotlhaya
O ne a newa khumo e ntsi thata
outcome.answer: E nnile sekao sa go ikotlhaya

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
